thesis: Flash loan + CLOB price manipulation: borrow large, move AMM price, exploit CLOB orders at stale prices
victim: CLOB makers with orders at pre-manipulation prices
asset: Token difference between AMM-distorted and CLOB-stated prices
evidence: CLOB fills use stored currentPrice (CLOBHelper.sol:180-239), not AMM curve price. No shared oracle between venues.

thesis: Controlled hook returns fake sqrtPriceX96 in SingleProviderPool, attacker swaps at rigged price
asset: Token output difference at manipulated vs fair price
evidence: Pool hook set at creation by LP, cannot be changed. Price bounded by MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO (SingleProviderPoolType.sol:328-330). Attacker-controlled pool only harms voluntary users (Tier B).

thesis: Dust-loop rounding extraction: iterated 1-wei swaps compound rounding errors
victim: LP reserves in any pool type
asset: Accumulated rounding dust over thousands of swaps
evidence: Rounding favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp for charges, mulDiv for payouts). Fuzz testing 36 tests confirms no round-trip profit. Max compound error is 1 wei per operation, not economically viable after gas.
